title: Dedupe the copy-pasted DB-wipe block in epic_26_story_23 — duplicate per-table delete calls in both tests
why: Both the multi-profile round-trip test and the C3-tombstone test wipe the database with the same ~17-statement manual delete sequence, each accidentally issuing the delete for two tables twice (streakEvents+completionEvents in the first block, completionEvents+streakEvents in the second) — harmless no-ops against an already-empty table, but evidence the block was copy-pasted rather than shared, so a future added/renamed table now needs updating in two independently-drifting copies.
recommendation: Extract a `_wipeAllUserTables(db)` test helper (one db.transaction, one delete per table) and call it from both tests.
acceptance_criteria: the two wipe blocks collapse to one shared helper with no duplicate per-table delete call
